name: jwander-temp-storage
description: A private-by-default temporary file service running entirely on Cloudflare.

scripts.build: pnpm build:client && cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.cf:lifecycle:add: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add cdn expire-temp-objects temp-storage/objects/ --expire-days 90
scripts.cf:lifecycle:list: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle list cdn
scripts.check: pnpm types:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:migrate:local: cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler d1 migrations apply jwander-temp-storage-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:client && cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm db:migrate:remote && cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p public/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.types:check: cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler types src/worker-configuration.d.ts --check && pnpm typecheck
